D27·9mvg — 2026-09-17
chose: The conformance goldens are runtime-neutral: the harness masks V8's JSON.parse position suffix (` (line N column M)`, added in Node 22) down to the `in JSON at position N` part, so the same golden asserts the same bytes on Node 20 and Node 24; the CLI's error text contract is untouched (it prints whatever its runtime says, and the Rust core keeps reproducing the Node 24 form its D13 fixtures pin). CI's engine suite becomes a Node 20 + 24 matrix (the declared floor is >=18), core-conformance runs on Node 24 (the runtime the core's message fixtures name), read-paths stays on 20. Replaces the aa0061c blanket move of every job to Node 24, which sofar-4c held as a support regression.
over: Pinning every CI job to Node 24 (drops coverage near the supported floor and would carry into main); asserting only the error code rather than the message (loses the message contract the golden was recording); recording per-runtime golden sets.
because: Only two goldens carried the suffix and only on TypeScript-only `event append` steps; a shape mask is the suite's existing tool for bytes a run cannot help minting differently (D4's ulid/timestamp masks), and it keeps the rest of the message asserted. The matrix keeps the floor honest at the cost of one more runner.
